telegramOn.label: Send the weekly/monthly digest to Telegram
telegramOn.help: Once a channel is on, the owner (or a staff member with the right permission) can send that period's digest with Reports › Funnels' "Run now" — totals for every tracked event and each saved funnel, this period against the one before it. Off as it ships; no automatic schedule is wired yet, the same gap the ad cost alerts (Marketing › Ad platforms) already ship with — only a manual run, nothing timed, until a shared report scheduler exists.

emailOn.label: Send the weekly/monthly digest by e-mail
emailOn.help: Needs the owner's e-mail address below; the e-mail channel sends nothing while that is empty, even with this on.

ownerEmail.label: Owner's e-mail address
ownerEmail.help: Where the digest e-mail goes. Empty until the owner types it (never shipped from one installation to another, CLAUDE.md rule 4).

lang.label: Digest language
lang.help: The language of both the Telegram message and the e-mail.
